title: OpWeave workflow document v1.0
description: Structure of a *.opweave.json workflow document with schemaVersion "1.0" (SPEC A2). Rules this schema cannot express are enforced elsewhere: the single-supplier rule (one input port may have at most one explicit supplier across dataEdges, inputBindings and node parameters; R1, checked by semantic validation) and the size limits (at most 200 nodes, a 1 MiB file and 64 KiB per string parameter value; OW-WF-008, checked by the serializer).

^x-.description: Extension member. Top-level x-* properties are preserved by serializer round-trips (SPEC A2).

schemaVersion.description: Workflow document schema version, fixed to "1.0" by this schema (SPEC A2).

id.description: Workflow ID. Grammar and uniqueness follow SPEC A4 (OW-WF-004/OW-WF-005).

title.description: Optional display and search title (SPEC A8).

description.description: Optional description for search and display (SPEC A8).

nodes.description: At least one node, and exactly one node with operation core.start (SPEC A2). The 200-node upper limit is stated here for documentation; it is enforced by the serializer (OW-WF-008).

dataEdges.description: Data flow edges between ports (SPEC A2). Each edge counts toward the single-supplier rule R1.

inputBindings.description: Bindings of workflow inputs to ports (SPEC A6). Each binding counts toward the single-supplier rule R1.

id.description: Node ID, unique within the workflow (SPEC A4 grammar).

parameters.description: Constant values keyed by input port name (SPEC A5). String parameter values are limited to 64 KiB (OW-WF-008). Each entry counts toward the single-supplier rule R1.

coreStartNode.description: Matches exactly the core.start nodes. Referenced by contains with minContains/maxContains 1 to require exactly one core.start node (SPEC A2).

fromPort.description: Optional control output port; defaults to "next". v1 accepts only "next" (OW-VAL-004).

fromInput.description: Workflow input id, which must be declared in inputs (SPEC A6).

required.description: Whether a value must be provided at run time.

default.description: Optional default value used when no run-time input value is given (SPEC A6).
